title: STLTH Loop Open Refillable Pod Pack
description:
Description
The STLTH Loop Open Pod is a 3ml open pod designed for convenience and performance, optimized for STLTH Salt Nic e-Liquid. Its transparent design provides clear visibility of e-Liquid levels, making it easy to monitor and refill when necessary. The coil offers up to 25,000 puffs per pod, it includes a coil life indication system with the Loop 3 device to ensure optimal performance throughout use.
Compatible with the STLTH Loop 3 device, it features adjustable airflow for a customizable vaping experience and a battery indicator to add ease of use. With its sleek, user-friendly design, the Loop Open Pod combines comfort and functionality.
Pack contains 2 pods.
Designed for full functionality with STLTH Loop 3 Devices.
Compatible with STLTH Loop 2 Devices, with limited feature functionality.
Refillable 3ml Capacity, Up to 25,000 Puffs Per Pod.
Coil Life Indication with STLTH Loop 3 Device’s E-liquid Indicator.
Optimized for STLTH Salt Nic E-liquids.
